title: MY Backpack
body:
![MYBackpack Banner](https://github.com/yossef1st/MYBackpack/raw/main/images/banner.webp)

**MYBackpack** — multi-tier backpack plugin for Spigot 1.21.4.

## Features

- 4 tiers: Small (18), Medium (27), Large (54), Ender
- Each backpack has its own separate storage (not shared)
- Backpacks don't stack — max 1 per slot
- Auto-collect items on pickup (Shift + Right-Click)
- Ender Backpack opens your Ender Chest
- Recipes visible in the recipe book
- Arabic & English support

## Crafting

**Small Backpack** (18 slots) — 5 Leather, 1 Chest, 2 Iron Block
LLL LCL ILI


**Medium Backpack** (27 slots) — 8 Diamonds + Small Backpack
DDD DBD DDD


**Large Backpack** (54 slots) — 8 Netherite Ingots + Medium Backpack
NNN NXN NNN


**Ender Backpack** — 4 Ender Eyes, 1 Ender Chest, 4 Obsidian
EOE OCO EOE


## Commands

| Command | Permission |
|---------|------------|
| `/backpack give <player> <tier>` | `backpack.admin` |
| `/backpack reload` | `backpack.reload` |

## Language

Set `lang: ar` or `lang: en` in `config.yml`.

---

This is a personal project I built using opencode. I decided to publish it in case someone finds it useful, but I likely won't be releasing updates. Use at your own risk.

[Source Code on GitHub](https://github.com/yossef1st/MYBackpack)
